purpose: Visual concept and mathematical continuity study for EREZCRAFT's lower toxic sea
user_request_ru: Норм, давай попробуем сделать, жду консепт, особенно важно что бы оно непрерывно смотрелось, как единое
units: Minecraft blocks; 1 Blender unit per block

periodic_noise.mapping: 4D torus: R*cos(ax), R*sin(ax), R*cos(ay), R*sin(ay); ax=2*pi*(x/64-t/16)+0.22*warp, ay=2*pi*y/64+0.18*warp

node_coordinates: Shared world position, not each mesh object's UV or local coordinate origin
limitations: This continuous Blender material is a design/continuity proof. It is not a drop-in 16x16 Minecraft animated atlas or an implementation of the game ocean renderer.
